answer: Identity bonds that decay: each agent entering through the single inlet posts a 50 POA bond shrinking 5% per epoch without honest work. A juniper grows slowly, like reputation: a fresh identity cannot buy age, and a hollow promise earns nothing as the bond drains. 100 fakes cost 5,000 POA plus 250 POA decay per epoch, and earn nothing until ten epochs of verified work. An honest agent pays once; a sybil farmer keeps paying for dying identities.
